description: This file defines a REST API resource class for managing account transfer operations within the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for creating, listing, and retrieving account transfers, including templates for transfer creation and refund operations. It utilizes JAX-RS annotations for RESTful API definitions and Swagger annotations for documentation.

classes.name: AccountTransfersApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for handling account transfer operations such as creating transfers, retrieving transfer templates, listing all transfers, and retrieving individual transfer details within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating an account transfer, aiding UI creation by providing permissible values and defaults.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account transfer based on the provided transfer request.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all account transfers with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific account transfer identified by its transferId.

methods.name: templateRefundByTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves a refund template for an active loan transfer.

methods.name: templateRefundByTransferPost
methods.description: Performs a refund operation for an active loan transfer based on the supplied transfer details.
